retained_changes: readFile enforces the Node 2 GiB boundary before allocating oversized files; abort validation shares the native AbortSignal validator with child execution; callback exceptions escape once.

WeakRef construction and successful dereference retain targets under stable heap roots until the Node host finishes a turn and its next ticks/microtasks; exposed gc performs collection and is installed before entry loading.
TCP transport records write-byte boundaries and delivers rooted completion callbacks after flush; destruction/cancellation and final cleanup release pending callbacks.
Removed the connect-listener queue that returned true indefinitely; native byte admission and captured writable replay avoid double accounting.
qualifications: The full 4k parallel goal remains incomplete; these focused checks are not a full-inventory result.
The native GC entry point is synchronous full collection. V8 asynchronous/minor GC options and debugger semantics are not qualified.
Filesystem async scheduling still uses the existing microtask bridge; comprehensive fd/directory/options snapshot behavior is not qualified.

TCP remains an asynchronous transport. Node may drain an individual OS write synchronously and return true where this transport returns false; the oracle checks verify eventual pressure, callback asynchrony, and byte preservation rather than identical kernel-progress-dependent thresholds.
The diagnostic 163-case network run used intermediate behavior and is not a final measurement. Its four former-pass regressions were isolated and recovered before retention.
